info.name: Summarize annotations created for a given dataset.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: datasetId
params.description: Filter the results by the OCID of the dataset.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose lifecycleState matches the given lifecycleState.

params.name: label
params.description: It summarizes annotations with the specified label.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. The default order is descending. If no value is specified, updatedBy is used by default.

params.name: annotationGroupBy
params.description: The field to group by. If no value is specified, updatedBy is used by default.

items.docs: Summarize the annotations created for a given dataset.
